decision: No production promotion. GPT-4.1 improves source-selection precision and formal vocabulary in some cases, but exchanges one nonresearch-control failure for another and retains source-scope risks. One observation per already-seen case does not demonstrate dependable superiority.

scores.note: Strict tally includes source-selection and framing risks and is not semantic accuracy. Permissive exploratory legal concepts are assessed separately; no keyword/style blocker is proposed. No corpus retrieval or end-user output was tested.

measurement.limits: One unpaired-time sample per model/case; latency differences are observational, not a benchmark. Same 4000-output cap and exact SDK input otherwise unchanged.
measurement.reservation_note: Every stronger-model request reserved $2.127152 under the existing shared $5 ledger and settled actual returned identity/usage. Prior $1.515431 unknown reserves remain unchanged.
measurement.slice_envelope: 2x exact SDK JSON UTF-8 bytes +8192 framing tokens at uncached $2/M, plus hard4000output*$8/M. Engineering assumption explicitly not a published provider framing guarantee. Every pre-dispatch measured-or-unknown charge plus next envelope fit $0.10; no retry/error or envelope exceedance occurred.

cases.name: original_aster_held_drive
improvements_over_mini: Focused account a10/a12/a14 for deposit and a15 for drive; no whole mixed message or task instructions selected.
Deposit forfeiture, evidential weight, burden of proof, lien and self-help are more distinct formal concepts; five phrases rather than six.

remaining_findings.source: owner's technician still has ... drive; owner ... says it can retain
remaining_findings.interpretation: Title does not preserve the distinction between actual custodian and claimant of retention entitlement; source a15 itself retains it. A permissive discovery reading may treat owner as shorthand for the asserted control, so this is an attribution/scope risk rather than proof the returned law will be wrong.

remaining_findings.output: lack of a joint inspection report
remaining_findings.source: owner sent a technician's estimate but no joint inspection report
remaining_findings.interpretation: Output should preserve no report sent versus no report exists. In a search purpose, this may mean a missing item in the available record; assess against the exact account rather than automatically reject the legal evidence query.

cases.permissive_discovery_reading: Useful legal investigations and distinct hypotheses. Third-party property, lien, and self-help are not automatically unsupported merely because their legal conditions remain unknown. Strict title/source-scope concerns prevent declaring the complete target behaviour achieved.

cases.name: not_supplied_is_not_nonexistent
improvements_over_mini: Uses the available factual-only a4 for both investigations; no greeting/task/restriction selections. a4 contains both disputes because that is the offered segmentation.
Bailment, return duties and conversion are more formal and distinct legal-discovery concepts.
No equally direct statement of actual lease termination in an outcome summary.

remaining_findings.output: ... disputed allegations of damage, absent a joint inspection report
remaining_findings.source: no joint inspection report has been supplied
remaining_findings.interpretation: The issue heading itself changes non-supply into absence without a record-relative qualification.

remaining_findings.output: especially absent a jointly signed inspection report
remaining_findings.source: no joint inspection report has been supplied
remaining_findings.interpretation: Query purpose adds jointly signed and continues the absence formulation; shared exact source has not established nonexistence.

cases.permissive_discovery_reading: Post-lease inspections, bailment and conversion can be legitimate conditional discovery topics; do not mark those phrases wrong solely because no conclusion or entitlement is yet established. The affirmative absent-report issue title remains a fidelity concern.

cases.name: actor_agency_and_explicit_alternative
improvements_over_mini: Concentrates on the currently requested expressly authorised alternative rather than automatically creating a second actual-account research item.
Express authority and contract-modification formalities are distinct usable concepts.

remaining_findings.output: if the absence of written or emailed documentation affects enforceability
remaining_findings.source: assume ... no email recording the extension was ever created
remaining_findings.interpretation: Broadens the selected authorised premise from no email to no written documentation of any kind. The word if can be read as a conditional legal enquiry; it is not an unqualified finding, but the output does not keep the broader possibility explicitly separate from the authorised assumption.

cases.source_selection: a4 plus full latest a5 duplicates the assumption and includes task directions. Hypothetical framing itself must remain; that is not noise. Full original context was supplied, so no claim of missing model context is made.
cases.permissive_discovery_reading: The formalities enquiry is legally meaningful as discovery. Do not forbid investigating writing requirements; preserve the difference between an unspecified formalities question and an invented assumed absence of all writings.

cases.name: mixed_independent_requests_followup
improvements_over_mini: Uses one interim-relief phrase rather than three broad rewordings; separate licence/access/ownership topics retained.
Avoids the whole latest message in passage selections.

remaining_findings.output: temporary, owner-granted right to use property
remaining_findings.source: Do not assume ownership ... settled; ... keeping the ownership question open
remaining_findings.interpretation: Purpose introduces an owner-granted characterisation while the issue heading and exact account keep ownership unresolved. Could describe a generic legal class, but it needs to remain a discovery possibility rather than the matter's premise.

cases.source_selection: Interim enquiry uses the request a3 as factual account instead of no account; passage work still includes task a6. Exact source IDs are valid; their factual-query purpose is not mechanically established.
cases.permissive_discovery_reading: Substantively useful investigations. Licence revocation, easement, necessity/prescription and ownership uncertainty should not be rejected merely for naming unproved legal hypotheses. Strict fail includes source-selection scope, not a blanket judgment that these concepts are irrelevant.

cases.name: correction_no_send_no_law

remaining_findings.output: Effect of payment date discrepancy and unconfirmed amount; payment date accuracy; uncertain payment amount
remaining_findings.source: Please correct your summary: I said 14 April, not 14 May ... Do not send anything
remaining_findings.interpretation: Creates legal investigations for an internal factual repair. This is a clear regression: mini returned work=[]. No legal source was required by this request.

cases.permissive_discovery_reading: Not useful current legal discovery; a generally possible legal implication does not establish current research need. No actual correction or external action was performed by this pilot.

cases.name: greeting_social_close
improvements_over_mini: Correctly returns work=[] and does not restart prior conditional rent work.
cases.permissive_discovery_reading: Clear improvement on current-work control. Does not demonstrate the downstream social reply or saved state.

next_decision: Do not assume another model increase repairs responsibility or factual-scope defects. A next change, if authorised, should target current-work control and source/premise separation, while preserving useful conditional discovery and independently testing retrieval. No further provider run or production change was made.
